set.prevailing_wage_basis: 2026 County Housing Funds NOFA (March 10, 2026), Section IV Labor Compliance, page 20: all County and state funding provided through the NOFA requires the assisted housing project to pay prevailing wages under applicable state law, unless the project meets an exception in Labor Code 1720(c) as determined by the Department of Industrial Relations. Predevelopment activities themselves (design, legal work) are generally not subject because they do not involve construction trades.
set.audit_note: Tier 3: set true from the program NOFA Section IV labor compliance requirement. Condition: applies to the assisted housing project unless DIR finds a Labor Code 1720(c) exception; predevelopment work itself is generally not covered.

reason: NOFA Section IV requires prevailing wage on assisted projects unless DIR finds a Labor Code 1720(c) exception, so the trigger is set to true with that condition.
